_comment: v1.5.9 — Section 09 executive films (one slot per card). Source of truth for scripts/v1.4.7/build.mjs (copies assets/<person>/ → dist/assets/exec/films/<person>/), dist/build-info.json (films[]), features/exec-films/exec-films.js (window.AtharExecFilms) and the QA suite. status: 'shipped' = file verified and served · 'coming-soon' = labelled ready slot, no file served. To ship a film later: drop the files into assets/<person>/, fill the entry, set status to shipped, run the build.
